title: Matching edge at a part position
statement: Let $q$ and $k$ be natural numbers, and let a perfect matching be given in the complete multipartite graph with $q$ parts of size $k$. For a part $i in bbr q$ and a position $j in bbr k$, the matching edge selected at the vertex $(i,j)$ is an edge of the matching.

A position j among k positions
